recent: A quiet guest-room dressing corner beside a large open window on a sunny morning — She checks the repaired hem of a short silk night robe on a wooden folding drying frame; the robe panel is lifted away by the frame as she unhooks it, revealing the already fully covering satin set underneath

a chemistry laboratory with a long worktable of glass flasks — writes in a notebook with a pen on the table

a sewing and alteration room with a cutting table — holds a cup in both hands
a kitchen or galley in her element's kingdom — standing
a hydrogen filling station at dusk — lying on her front

a mine gallery of rough rock walls — sitting on the ground
